svg.title: BharatHealth Analyst: A tool-using LLM analyst over India's district health survey, with its own benchmark.
svg.desc: BharatHealth Analyst project card. Role: sole author. Key results: 200 benchmark Qs, computed ground truth; 71.1% / 5.0% exact-answer accuracy / hallucination; 706 × 448 districts × columns, DVC-reproducible.
